summary: Backend regression testing after removal of hardcoded .to_list(1000)/.to_list(50000) limits in server.py and services/*.py. Created new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_unbounded_limits.py with 7 tests. All 7 passed. No 500s, no timeouts, all endpoints respond in <1s despite unbounded queries against 11,767-transaction DB.

minor.issue: For months 2026-01/02/03 (the only months with data - 10,930 sales exist) both silver_profit_kg and labor_profit_inr return 0 even after POST /api/analytics/recompute-summaries (recomputed=1575). Additivity technically holds (0==0) so the limit-fix does not regress. However zero profit against 10.9k sale records suggests purchase_ledger / cost-basis engine may be empty or misaligned with sales data in the test DB. This is NOT caused by the current limit-removal fix (pre-existing data or profit_helpers cost-basis issue). Worth investigating separately.

action_items: Investigate why /api/analytics/monthly-profit and /api/analytics/daily-profit return silver_profit_kg=0 and labor_profit_inr=0 for months that contain 10,930 sales (2026-01..2026-03). Possibly missing purchase_ledger entries for the imported items, or profit_helpers cost-basis lookup mismatch. Not a regression from the limit fix but noteworthy for data integrity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>6900 lines with 20+ occurrences of the same `db.item_groups.find().to_list(None)` boilerplate). Consider extracting an `_all_item_groups()` helper to enforce the unbounded contract in one place - reduces risk of a future dev reintroducing a truncating limit.

Endpoint naming inconsistency: request mentioned `/api/dashboard/stats` and `/api/visualization-data` but actual routes are `/api/stats` and `/api/analytics/visualization`. Consider aligning docs/frontend to avoid confusion.
